title: Nat Kobitz as Coulthart's original Navy source

tellings.quote: Uh you know, Nat Kobitz, who was a, you know, a senior Navy scientist who was kind of Ross Coldart's original source that really brought him down the rabbit hole.

plain: A senior Navy scientist named Nat Kobitz was the original source who first drew the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart into UFO research, sending him, in Michels' words, "down the rabbit hole." Michels says this himself, without saying how he knows it. If true, it would mean that Coulthart's reporting started with an insider in the Navy's own science world.
